feed.title: Track Awesome Connectivity Info Updates Daily
feed.subtitle: Awesome list of connectivity indexes and reports to help you better under who has access to communication infrastructure and on what terms.

entry.title: Awesome Connectivity Info Updates on Nov 04, 2026
entry.content:
Global Indexes

  • cable.co.uk Worldwide Broadband Price Comparison - Index of broadband costs around the world based on fixed line and wireless access. (2023) (2022) (2019) (2018)

Global Indexes / Discontinued

  • A4AI Affordability Drivers Index - Index of internet affordability by the Alliance for Affordable Internet Access (last published 2021). (2021) (2020)
  • A4AI Mobile Broadband Data Costs - Price of broadband data (1GB mobile prepaid) as % of GNI per capita (last published 2020). (2020) (Q4 2018) (2017)

Connectivity Maps / Discontinued

  • Global CDN Infrastructure Map - Open data map of Content Distribution Networks around the world hosted by NSRC (May 2024).
  • TeleGeography Africa Telecoms Map - Map of African telecoms including undersea cables, international bandwidth, and cloud data centres. (2025) (2024)
  • TeleGeography Submarine Cable Map - Interactive submarine fibre optic cables.
  • TeleGeography Annual Submarine Cable Update - Annual print editions of the submarine cable map. (2026) (2025) (2024) (2023) (2022) · archive
  • TeleGeography Cloud Infrastructure Map - Map of cloud infrastructure providers around the world.
  • Hurricane Electric 3D Map - Interactive 3D map of undersea cables and Hurricane Electric Points of Presence (POPs) and routes.
  • nperf Mobile Coverage Maps - Mobile coverage based on data collected from the nperf app.

Periodic Global Reports / Discontinued

  • We Are Social / Meltwater Digital - Annual report on internet and social media adoption. (2026) (2025) (2024) (2023) (2022) · archive
  • GSMA Mobile Gender Gap Report - Gender gaps in mobile ownership and mobile internet use in low- and middle-income countries. (2026) (2025) (2024) (2023) (2022) · archive
  • Broadband Commission: The State of Broadband - Annual flagship report on broadband access, affordability, and use. (2025) (2024) (2023) (2022) (2021) · archive
  • GSMA State of Mobile Internet Connectivity - Trends in global mobile internet connectivity and barriers to adoption. (2026) (2025) (2024) (2023) (2022) · archive
  • ITU Global Connectivity Report - Detailed assessment of the current state of connectivity. (2025) (2022)
  • ITU Measuring Digital Development - Facts and Figures annual estimates of global connectivity. (2026) (2025) (LLDCs 2025) (2024) (2024 Small Island States) · archive
  • ITU Measuring Digital Development: ICT Price Trends - Analysis and comparison of price data for mobile-voice services, mobile data and fixed broadband. Replaces the Measuring the Information Society Report. (2024) (2019)
  • UN E-Government Survey - Global E-Government and E-Participation Development Index; underlying country data in the UN E-Government Knowledge Database. (2024) (2022) (2020) (2018) (2016)
  • Mozilla Internet Health Report - Annual look at the health of the internet (last published 2020). (2020) (2019) (2018)
  • ITU Measuring the Information Society - Earlier ITU series on ICT development, later replaced by Measuring Digital Development (discontinued). (2018) (2017)
  • Deloitte - Global Mobile Consumer Trends - Survey of mobile consumer behaviour across markets (discontinued).

Regional Reports and Data / Discontinued

  • GSMA Mobile Economy - Middle East & North Africa - Regional Mobile Economy report for MENA. (2025) (2024) (2023) (2022)
  • GSMA Mobile Economy - West Africa - Regional Mobile Economy report for West Africa. (2019) (2018)
  • GSMA Mobile Economy - Sub-Saharan Africa - Regional Mobile Economy report for Sub-Saharan Africa. (2024) (2023) (2022) (2021) (2020) · archive
  • GSMA Mobile Economy - Africa - Continent-wide Mobile Economy report for Africa. (2026) (2025) (2016)
  • GSMA Mobile Economy - Latin America - Regional Mobile Economy report for Latin America. (2026) (2024) (2022) (2021)
  • GSMA Mobile Economy - Asia Pacific - Regional Mobile Economy report for Asia Pacific. (2026) (2025) (2024) (2021) (2020)
  • Development and Access to Information (DA2i) Regional Reports - Dashboards profiling Connectivity, Freedom, and Gender Equity by the TASCHA group at the University of Washington, funded by IFLA.
  • African Telecommunications Infrastructure Development - Series on African telecom infrastructure at manypossibilities.net (2014–2023).
  • RIA Africa Mobile Pricing (RAMP) Indices Portal - Pricing information on Voice/SMS basket, 1GB data basket, and Value For Money bundles (Q3 2022).
  • Opera - State of the Mobile Web Africa - Opera reports on mobile web use in Africa (last published 2019). (2019) (2016)
  • Ericsson Mobility Report - Sub-Saharan Africa - Regional closer look from the Ericsson Mobility Report. (2024) (2015)
  • Opensignal - The State of Mobile Network Experience in Africa - Download speeds and network quality in 27 African countries (November 2024).
  • Lions go digital: The Internet's transformative potential in Africa - Report by McKinsey on the potential impact of the Internet in Africa (last published 2013).

Data and Measurement / Discontinued

  • Opensignal - State of Mobile Networks Reports - Country reports based on Opensignal data gathering.

entry.title: Awesome Connectivity Info Updates on Oct 28, 2024
entry.content:

entry.title: Awesome Connectivity Info Updates on Mar 01, 2019
entry.content:
Global Indexes / Discontinued

  • World Economic Forum - Networked Readiness Index - Earlier WEF edition of the Networked Readiness Index; succeeded by the Portulans Network Readiness Index (discontinued).
  • Cisco Visual Networking Index - Forecast and Trends, 2017–2022 White Paper (discontinued).

Connectivity Maps / Discontinued

  • African Undersea Cables - Steve Song's map of African undersea fibre optic cables.
  • African Terrestrial Fibre Optic Infrastructure - Map of African terrestrial fibre networks, Creative Commons, Open Data.
  • Africa Bandwidth Maps - Paul Hamilton's map of African terrestrial fibre and microwave networks.
  • GSMA Mobile Coverage Maps @ Mobile World Live - Somewhat dated but still useful map of mobile network coverage on a country-by-country basis.
  • ITU Broadband Atlas - Interactive infographic tool showcasing the status of broadband deployment worldwide and the regulatory landscape for broadband (discontinued).

Periodic Global Reports / Discontinued

  • Akamai State of the Internet / Connectivity Report - Connectivity report from large CDN company (last published 2017).
  • World Economic Forum - Global Information Technology Report - Examines the role of ICTs in driving innovation and includes the Network Readiness Index (discontinued).

Data and Measurement / Discontinued

  • Global Stats by StatCounter - Browser market share over time by browser, region, and OS.
  • Global Mobile Suppliers Association - Reports on LTE and 5G adoption.
  • InternetLiveStats - Internet users by country, interpolated from ITU, United Nations Population Division, Internet & Mobile Association of India (IAMAI), and World Bank data.
  • Internet World Stats - Internet users compiled from Nielsen and ITU statistics.
  • SimilarWeb - Mobile App Ranking - Ranking of popular mobile apps across countries.
  • LTE, WiMAX, HSPA+, 3G, GSM information by country - List of mobile networks around the world and their associated frequencies.

Data and Measurement / One-off reports

  • GSMA - Enabling Rural Coverage - Regulatory and policy recommendations to foster mobile broadband coverage in developing countries (last published 2018).
  • WEF Internet for All - Framework for accelerating internet access and adoption (last published 2016).
  • Kleiner Perkins Mary Meeker Internet Trends Report - Trends that affect and drive internet uptake globally (last published 2018).
